test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active form.

A lot of masks have been distributed by the social workers.

options.text: The social workers are distributing a lot of masks.
The social workers have distributed a lot of masks.
The social workers had distributed a lot of masks.
The social workers would distribute a lot of masks.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in passive voice.
 
• Passive voice structure: *object + auxiliary verb (has/have been) + past participle + by + subject*.
 
• The given sentence: "A lot of masks have been distributed by the social workers."
 
• To convert it into active voice, make "the social workers" the subject.
 
• Change the verb "have been distributed" to "have distributed."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The social workers have distributed a lot of masks."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The social workers are distributing a lot of masks." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to present continuous.
 
• **Option 3: **"The social workers had distributed a lot of masks." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to past perfect.
 
• **Option 4: **"The social workers would distribute a lot of masks." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to conditional.
